banner.title: Cookies
banner.text: We use necessary cookies to run this site. With your permission we also use marketing cookies from Meta and Google to see which ads bring visitors. Our visit statistics are anonymous and use no cookies.

settings.title: Cookie settings
settings.description: Choose what we may use. You can change it anytime under “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Language, sign-in, this choice and the link you came from. Always on.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Anonymous visit statistics, without cookies or personal data.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Meta and Google measure which ads bring visitors. They set their own cookies.
